Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory786.jpg'}
{3: 'The sky deepens to dark violet, its color bleeding from the horizon down into the waiting waves.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1573.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1573.jpg'}

{3: 'Patrons drift away in scattered clusters, waving their goodbyes into the evening. Some pause to leave kind words behind, praising the way your voices wove together. Others offer wistful sighs, murmuring that the time slipped away far too quickly.'}

{3: "As the excitement settles and you gather what remains scattered across the small stage, a certain quiet loneliness begins to creep in at the edges. Perhaps that's only natural after such warmth."}
{3: 'Your mind still feels flushed, stubbornly holding onto the last embers of that shared joy.'}
{3: 'Then, something cool presses softly against your cheek. You turn on instinct, startled.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'idle', 3: 'idle_blink', 4: 'AC_cszl_to_idle'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Selena stifles a giggle behind her hand, the sparkle in her eyes betraying the success of her small, sweet scheme.'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'Conductor, you must be thirsty after all that singing. Here.', 4: '101', 18: '100018401', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{3: 'She presses a chilled bottle of water into your hands.'}
{3: "As you take it, she quietly relieves you of whatever you'd been tidying up."}
{1: '1', 2: 'AC_cszl', 3: 'AC_cszl_blink'}

{2: 'Owner', 3: "Oh, I just... I really can't thank you two enough for tonight. You gave this old place something beautiful. And I don't have much to offer in return, but...", 4: '102', 18: '100018404', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6601_12.jpg'}
{3: "You lean in to look. It's a photograph, taken at sunset."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6601_12.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}

{3: "In it, you and Selena sit side by side, instruments cradled in your hands, the day's last light caught like gold thread in your hair. Selena's gaze rests on you, soft and tender—something you hadn't noticed at the time."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6601_12.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1'}
{3: 'A snapshot of life itself, unposed and real.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1573.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Selena holds the photo, lingering in the moment it captured.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Owner', 3: 'Right as the music started. The light just happened to fall across you two perfectly. I saw it and thought, "That\'s one worth keeping." Old habits, I suppose.', 4: '102', 18: '100018406', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Owner', 3: 'And I left a little something on the back... See? Two whales.', 4: '102', 18: '100018407', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}
{3: 'She gently turns the photo over and points to the two whales drawn there—simple strokes of ink, but full of heart.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Owner', 3: "That's right! See, here's a little island wisdom for you: whales are travelers. Every summer, they journey to colder waters, following the currents, feeding beneath the long light.", 4: '102', 18: '100018409', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Owner', 3: 'And every year, right around this time, we hear them again. Their songs drift up from the deep. They always come back.', 4: '102', 18: '100018410', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}

{2: 'Owner', 3: 'So around here, whales came to mean something more. Companionship that endures. Bonds that cross great distances and still return home. May their spirit bless you both the same way.', 4: '102', 18: '100018478', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Owner', 3: "Alright, alright! Weren't you two just saying you wanted to catch one last walk along the shore? Stop staring at that photo. You'll have plenty of time to study it later!", 4: '102', 18: '100018412', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Owner', 3: "Being happy in this moment isn't the whole story, you know. You've got a long, long road ahead to walk together.", 4: '102', 18: '100018413', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}

{2: 'Owner', 3: "You! Promise me you'll stay beside her. That days like today won't be the last of their kind. Otherwise, that blessing I scribbled on the back won't mean a thing!", 4: '102', 18: '100018414', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'You have my word.', 3: '80'}
{3: 'The earnestness in your voice draws warm laughter from both the owner and Selena.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Owner', 3: "Good. Now off with you! The view won't wait, and it's just hitting its prime out there. I'll handle the rest here. Go on!", 4: '102', 18: '100018415', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory786.jpg'}
{3: 'Like guests drifting home from a lovely gathering, the two of you wander together along the winding path beside the shore.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Selena', 3: "Conductor, I'm sorry. We were meant to arrive at sunset.", 4: '101', 18: '100018416', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'It was my whim, pulling us into that little performance.', 4: '101', 18: '100018417', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "And now... we've missed the very thing this beach is known for.", 4: '101', 18: '100018418', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: "Don't apologize. The view right now is just as beautiful.", 3: '95'}
{3: "The waves roll gently, carrying the moon's reflection in fragments across the water, scattering whatever melancholy thoughts might have lingered across the sand."}
{1: '1', 2: 'AC_cszl', 3: 'AC_cszl_blink'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Selena', 3: "Conductor, what did tonight's performance feel like to you?", 4: '101', 18: '100018419', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}

{2: 'Selena', 3: "I truly cherish moments like these. I've always believed that art reaches into the heart of the living and gives shape to what we feel. It makes it real and tangible. Something we can almost hold.", 4: '101', 18: '100018420', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{3: 'Her fingers find the hem of her dress, worrying the fabric in a quiet, absent gesture. Across the sand, her shadow wavers and shifts, bleeding into the faint moonlight.'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'Years from now... when we look back on this night, what will we remember?', 4: '101', 18: '100018421', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: '1', 2: 'idle', 3: 'idle_blink', 4: 'AC_cszl_to_idle'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "We probably won't recall the notes that slipped away from us. Maybe not even which songs we played...", 4: '101', 18: '100018422', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}

{2: 'Selena', 3: 'But the color of the sunset... the warmth lingering in the evening air... the feeling we carried in our hearts while we played... and who was beside us through all of it... All of it will return like the tide, quietly filling every hollow of memory.', 4: '101', 18: '100018423', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'I think... that is the warmth of art.', 4: '101', 18: '100018424', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Selena, do you remember?', 3: '113'}
{2: 'It was another summer night, just like this one. I got a letter from Constellia.', 3: '114'}
{3: 'Before the words are even finished, Selena lets out a soft, knowing laugh.'}
{2: 'The letter was signed by "Iris". I searched up and down the shore, but I couldn\'t find her anywhere.', 3: '117'}
{2: 'So I played a piece we both knew. I hoped... she might hear it. And find her way to me.', 3: '119'}
{2: 'And that melody had already filled the night sky once before.', 3: '121'}
{3: "Resignation, joy, relief—a whole tapestry of feeling flickers through Selena's gentle gaze, shifting like light on water."}
{2: "Because of you. Because of that song. I know I'll carry that night with me always.", 3: '124'}
{2: "And tonight, I finally kept the promise I couldn't fulfill that day.", 3: '125'}
{3: 'Selena lowers her head, as though weighing something delicate.'}

{2: 'Selena', 3: "Music has that kind of magic, doesn't it? It reaches back and holds the past for us... while somehow making us look forward to what's still to come.", 4: '101', 18: '100018426', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: '1', 2: 'AC_cszl', 3: 'AC_cszl_blink', 4: 'idle_to_AC_cszl'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "Conductor, I've had this feeling all day, actually.", 4: '101', 18: '100018427', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}

{2: 'Selena', 3: 'Watching the people here... how they live, how they love, how they simply are together... I keep wondering what life might look like once everything settles.', 4: '101', 18: '100018428', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}

{2: 'Selena', 3: 'I catch myself imagining... perhaps when all of this is over, you and I could have something like this too. Like the owner and her husband.', 4: '101', 18: '100018429', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: '1', 2: 'idle', 3: 'idle_blink', 4: 'AC_cszl_to_idle'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "Every little moment. Ordinary, unremarkable... and utterly precious. We'd hold each one close.", 4: '101', 18: '100018430', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory782.jpg'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Selena', 3: 'In the mornings, we could linger a little longer beneath the covers, trade sleepy words, and steal those soft, unhurried hours before the world wakes up.', 4: '118', 18: '100018431', 19: '18', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory783.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory783.jpg'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Selena', 3: "In the evenings, as the sun sinks low, we'd share the small pieces of our day, everything from what we ate for dinner to whatever's been resting heavy on our hearts.", 4: '118', 18: '100018432', 19: '18', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'Trivial things. Important things. The people who drift through our lives. The universe. Distant stars...', 4: '118', 18: '100018433', 19: '18', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1302.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1302.jpg'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "And we'd still write to each other on special days. Preserving our feelings in ink, tucking them away.", 4: '118', 18: '100018434', 19: '18', 21: 'v460summer'}

{2: 'Selena', 3: "And years from then, when we're sorting through old books, we'll find those words again, yellowed by time, but still warm to the touch...", 4: '118', 18: '100018435', 19: '18', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory609.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory609.jpg'}

{2: 'Selena', 3: "We might live a long, simple life together. Hardship will find us, I'm sure, as it always does. But we'll fill the spaces between with joy, laughter, music, and conversations.", 4: '118', 18: '100018436', 19: '18', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory786.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Selena', 3: "We have so much time ahead of us, Conductor. And our life together... it's only just beginning.", 4: '101', 18: '100018437', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Yeah... we have all the time in the world.', 3: '169'}
{3: 'The warmth of the gathering still lingers in the salt-tinged air.'}
{3: "Life here moves slowly, woven from small, unremarkable details. But that's what ordinary life truly looks like. That's the shape of it."}
{3: 'However...'}
{1: '1', 2: 'AC_cszl', 3: 'AC_cszl_blink'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "Our time here is borrowed. This life... it doesn't belong to us. Not yet.", 4: '101', 18: '100018439', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{3: 'A note of melancholy slips into her voice, soft as the moonlight pooling on the sand.'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "The shadow hanging over this planet hasn't lifted. No one can say when it will.", 4: '101', 18: '100018440', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'We still have work waiting for us.', 4: '101', 18: '100018441', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'This peace only holds because of what others have given up to protect it.', 4: '101', 18: '100018442', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: '1', 2: 'idle', 3: 'idle_blink', 4: 'AC_cszl_to_idle'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "But the songs this world creates... they aren't only woven from pain and sorrow. From loss and heroism.", 4: '101', 18: '100018443', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'They can be joyful, too. Bright. Full of hope. Just like the melodies the islanders hum without even thinking.', 4: '101', 18: '100018444', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "And our voices... they're more than a single verse in that endless song. They're threaded with joy, touched by partings.", 4: '101', 18: '100018445', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{3: 'She falls quiet. Barefoot, she walks along the shoreline, her footprints pressing into the wet sand—some deep, some faint, marking an uneven path.'}
{3: 'But unlike the long road she once walked alone, another set of prints now runs beside hers, matching her stride.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_01.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangEnd'}
{3: 'Perhaps weary from the walk, she settles onto a weathered chair by the shore. From within her clothes, she draws out a folded letter.'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'A letter addressed to the sea.', 18: '100018446'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "I've heard the people here believe the ocean carries good fortune and blessings.", 18: '100018447'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_02.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "So I want to do the same. I want to believe in the sea. To believe the world might hear what I'm asking for.", 18: '100018448'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "The owner... she wanted to hold onto the past. But I want to give our time to what's still ahead.", 18: '100018449'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "Conductor, I think you already know what I'm wishing for.", 18: '100018450'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_03.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_06.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_04.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_04.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_05.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_07.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{3: 'She bends down and picks up a small glass bottle, smoothed and worn by the tide.'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "After being apart for so long, I've learned to hold these fragile, fleeting moments close.", 18: '100018451'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "I've missed too many of your days already. But from now on... I want to be beside you, feeling time pass, watching the tide rise... and fall.", 18: '100018452'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_08.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangEnd'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_09.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'To share the dull days with you. The frustrating ones. The joyful ones. The ones that feel like bliss. Even when our lives are marked by constant goodbyes.', 18: '100018453'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "But after all we've weathered... I'm strong enough now. Strong enough to bear even the longest separations.", 18: '100018454'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'Sorrow will end someday. And our new life, our real life together, will begin. Soon, I hope.', 18: '100018455'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_01_10.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangEnd'}
{2: '...Want to put this photo in there too?', 3: '278'}
{3: "You reach for the photograph, the one taken at sunset, and place it gently in Selena's hand."}
{2: 'I hope that days like this... will someday be our ordinary. The sea will hear us.', 3: '280'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_01.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangEnd'}
{3: 'She carefully folds the photograph, slips it into the bottle, and seals it tight.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_02.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_02.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_03.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_03.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_04.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_04.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_05.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_05.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{3: "The bottle rests at the water's edge. White-capped waves nudge it playfully, as though testing its weight, before a larger swell claims it and carries it off toward the moonlit horizon."}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_07.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_08.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_09.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_10.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangEnd'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_06.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{3: 'She shifts closer. The warmth of her presence—synthetic skin cooled by the evening air, softened by the ocean breeze—settles over your tired mind, easing it into something like peace.'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_11.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_13.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_14.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangEnd'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_12.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_12.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{3: 'Gently, she rests her head against your shoulder.'}
{2: '(Shift closer to her)', 3: '336'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_12.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.2'}
{3: 'She has imagined a moment like this countless times before.'}
{3: 'On her travels. Beneath starlit skies, singing alone. In the quiet hours spent penning letters.'}
{3: 'Moonlight spills across the dark water as the bottle drifts along, bobbing gently with the rhythm of the sea.'}
{3: 'For a long while, neither of you speaks. There is only the sound of the waves. The steady rise and fall of breathing. The occasional soft creak of the wooden bench beneath you.'}
{3: "Until the bottle drifts into the moon's reflection on the water, dissolving into the stillness of the night."}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_02_12.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'I hope the sea hears our wishes.', 18: '100018457'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'Conductor... I wish this day could last just a little longer. Just a little more.', 18: '100018458'}

{2: 'Selena', 3: 'If only time would slow its pace... I could imprint every detail of this moment into my memory. The scent of the sea breeze. The way the moonlight shifts across the water. This warmth, right here...', 18: '100018459'}
{2: 'Yeah... The moon really is beautiful tonight.', 3: '358'}
{3: 'She pauses, as though gathering something fragile in her chest. Then she speaks again.'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'But time waits for no one. And tonight will slip through our fingers before we know it...', 18: '100018460'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: "Still... maybe there's something missing. One more song. An encore that belongs only to us.", 18: '100018461'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_01.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangEnd'}
{3: 'She rises to her feet, her voice soft but steady, carried on the sea breeze.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_02.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_03.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.6'}
{2: 'Selena', 3: 'Conductor, if you would, will you share this final song with me? To close the night?', 18: '100018462'}
{3: 'She extends her hand, inviting you to share one last dance as the final note to carry this day into memory.'}
{2: '(Hold her hand)', 3: '384'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_04.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'AniZhuanchangEnd'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_05.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{3: "Without any accompaniment, she begins to hum softly. It's a melody you know by heart, one you've listened to together countless times before."}
{3: 'In the distance, a deep, resonant breath rises from the ocean.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_06.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiEnd.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab'}

{3: "A whale breaks the surface, its vast tail carving a gleaming arc through the night air before crashing back down. A moment later, a brilliant plume of water erupts skyward, shattering into countless silver stars beneath the moon's quiet gaze."}
{3: 'Then, another.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_06.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_06.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{3: 'The scattered light veils the night in a thin, shimmering gauze, and within this half-dream of salt and starlight, the two of you begin to dance.'}
{3: 'After a long and solitary journey, the whale has finally returned to the place she was always meant to be.'}
{3: 'A passage through cold, dark depths, witnessed by no one.'}
{3: 'A hope cradled in the lightless abyss, impossible to be heard.'}
{3: 'A confession sung beneath a sky full of stars, with nowhere to send it.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_07.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_08.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{3: 'Her voice draws you in, soft as a tide. You find yourself leaning closer.'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_09.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.2'}
{3: 'Closer still. Her humming fades, and now you can almost hear the gentle rhythm of her breathing.'}
{3: 'Her voice falls away entirely, leaving only the distant whale song and the slow, steady pulse of the waves.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1573.jpg'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Deputy Village Head', 3: "Sorry I'm late! I know, I know. There was just so much to sort out with the relocation. I tried everything to get back in time for the restaurant's last night, but...", 4: '101', 18: '100018463', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{2: 'Deputy Village Head', 3: '...But I brought your favorite flowers! As a peace offering. Will you forgive me?', 4: '101', 18: '100018464', 19: '1', 21: 'v460summer'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Owner', 3: 'Oh, honestly... Look at you. At our age, still showing up with flowers like a lovesick boy!', 4: '102', 18: '100018465', 19: '2', 21: 'v460summer'}
{3: 'The owner takes the bouquet and breathes in its scent, her expression softening.'}
{3: "Just then, a whale's song drifts in from the distance."}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgComic/V460Selena/V460_03_06.jpg'}
{1: "She looks up. Beyond the dark shape of the whale, she sees two silhouettes bathed in the moon's soft glow.", 5: '1'}
{1: 'Moonlight filters through the trees, brushing their shadows in silver across the sand. The two silhouettes draw closer, their footprints weaving across the sand.'}
{1: 'In them, she sees herself. A younger version, a lifetime ago.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1573.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1573.jpg'}
{1: 'The owner falls still, lost in the sweet ache of days long past. Beside her, her husband gently draws her close, his arm settling around her shoulders.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'They hope this beautiful moment might be preserved for the two of them. A silent wish, offered over and over again.'}
{1: 'The photographs on the wall remain untouched, as if waiting for someone to gather them up together.', 7: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg'}
{1: 'To the Sea,', 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 6: '1', 7: '1'}

{1: "I've thought long and hard. And still, I find myself unsure how to shape this wish into language.", 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018466', 6: '1', 7: '1'}
{1: "But this much I know: we must keep living. Life doesn't pause for permission.", 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018467', 6: '1', 7: '1'}

{1: 'There are so many days still waiting for us. A long, unspooling stretch of ordinary mornings and quiet nights.', 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018468', 6: '1', 7: '1'}

{1: "Whatever trials come, whatever hardships find us along the way, we'll face them together. With patience woven between us like a familiar melody.", 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018469', 6: '1', 7: '1'}
{1: "We'll work toward our happiness. We'll write—for life, and for art.", 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018470', 6: '1', 7: '1', 8: '1'}
{1: 'And when the future finally opens its hands to us, I believe fate will be kind.', 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018471', 6: '1', 7: '1'}

{1: "When happiness arrives, we'll speak of the long years we endured to reach it. We'll remember the tears we shed through the heartache, and they won't feel like wounds anymore.", 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018472', 6: '1', 7: '1'}

{1: "And then we'll finally see it. A life brimming with splendor. With joy. With the kind of beauty that doesn't shout, but lingers.", 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018473', 6: '1', 7: '1'}

{1: "We'll look back on these difficult days and smile. And at last, we'll taste what happiness truly is.", 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018474', 6: '1', 7: '1', 8: '1'}
{1: 'I believe we will.', 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018475', 6: '1', 7: '1'}
{1: 'I believe this. With every part of me.', 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018476', 6: '1', 7: '1'}

{1: 'Because the best moments are the ones spent side by side. And the longest song, the one that never truly ends, is life itself.', 2: '0066ccff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 5: '100018477', 6: '1', 7: '1'}
{1: ' —Iris', 2: '0066ccff', 3: '1', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1207.jpg', 6: '1', 7: '1', 10: '1'}
